EDC Orlando 2026 in Review: Best Sets, Big Upgrades and What Needs Fixing

By PLURGASM @plurgasm ⏱ 7 min read

EDC Orlando turned 15 this year, and it threw itself a proper party. Over three nights, November 6 to 8, more than 95,000 people a day filled Tinker Field next to Camping World Stadium[3]. Here is our look back at the best sets, the stage upgrades, what still needs fixing, and what is already locked in for 2027.

In This Recap

  • The Quick Take
  • Best Sets of the Weekend
  • Stages & Production
  • What Got Better
  • What Still Needs Work
  • Hotel EDC Orlando
  • EDC Orlando 2027

The Quick Take

  • Sunday was the techno night of the year. Holy Priest closed circuitGROUNDS, Klangkuenstler closed neonGARDEN, and Boys Noize went back to back with Brutalismus 3000. Picking between them was the hardest call of the weekend.
  • The mainstage delivered. David Guetta closed Friday, Kaskade closed Saturday, and Hardwell into Martin Garrix closed out Sunday.
  • The grounds felt better. Reviewers credited wider walkways, free water stations and less crowding at the big stages[1][5].
  • Phone theft is still a problem, especially near the end of the night[1].
  • 2027 is already set: November 5 to 7, back at Tinker Field[8].

Best Sets of the Weekend

This year's lineup leaned hard into house and techno (we called it in our lineup breakdown). That bet paid off. Here are the sets people kept talking about.

Holy Priest closes circuitGROUNDS (Sunday)

circuitGROUNDS is usually where Orlando's bassheads live, so handing its final slot of the weekend to a hard techno act was a statement. Holy Priest played the 10:55 PM to midnight closer on Sunday[7], under the stage's huge screens, pyro and hanging acrobats. EDMTunes named him among the standouts of a stacked Sunday techno run[1].

Klangkuenstler closes neonGARDEN (Sunday)

At the same time across the grounds, Klangkuenstler played a 90-minute closer at neonGARDEN from 10:30 PM to midnight[7]. EDMTunes called him the "headmaster" of schranz[1], the fast, pounding German hard techno style. With Holy Priest, Klangkuenstler and Martin Garrix all playing at once, The Festival Babes summed up Sunday stage-hopping as "a serious dilemma"[5].

Boys Noize b2b Brutalismus 3000 (Sunday)

The back-to-back we flagged in June as a "dark-techno fever dream" happened at neonGARDEN on Sunday[2]. Boys Noize stayed in town for Hotel EDC afterward too[1].

The rest of the Sunday techno run

Sunday at neonGARDEN was wall-to-wall techno. EDMTunes singled out SHDW, KI/KI, Marlon Hoffstadt and Adrián Mills[1], and The Festival Babes called the whole day "a techno head's dream"[5]. EDMTunes also praised I Hate Models and Nico Moreno for high-intensity, storytelling sets[1].

Hardwell into Martin Garrix (Sunday)

kineticFIELD's Sunday night was pure big-room nostalgia. SLANDER played the sunset set, then Alok, then Hardwell from 9:15 to 10:25 PM, and finally Martin Garrix closed the festival from 10:28 to 11:56 PM[2][7].

Kaskade, KREAM and SLANDER on the mainstage

EDMTunes picked KREAM, Kaskade and SLANDER as the mainstage sets that best balanced emotional and upbeat[1]. Kaskade closed kineticFIELD on Saturday[7]. On Friday, a "Space Rave" interlude bridged KREAM and Afrojack before David Guetta closed the night[2].

Bass highlights

The bass side of the lineup was lighter than past years, with no Subtronics. The sets that did happen still landed. EDMTunes praised Level Up, Adventure Club, Jkyl & Hyde, Levity, AVELLO and Sippy, plus Of The Trees, whose sunset set mixed trap with heavy wubs[1]. Alison Wonderland closed circuitGROUNDS on Saturday and Wooli closed it on Friday[7]. CBS12 named Alison Wonderland, Ray Volpe and ALLEYCVT as Saturday's bass leaders[2]. Not sure what genre any of these artists play? Look them up in our bass artist genre directory.

House and garage

EDMTunes called Josh Baker, AYYBO, Interplanetary Criminal, Mau P and Roddy Lima some of the best sets of the weekend[1]. Josh Baker closed neonGARDEN on Friday, and Chris Lorenzo closed stereoBLOOM[7]. On Saturday, Miami's Club Space and Brooklyn's Factory 93 teamed up to host neonGARDEN[2].

Stages & Production

  • kineticFIELD dropped last year's owl look for a retro boombox design[5], running the kineticJOURNEY visuals carried over from EDC Las Vegas[1]. Fireworks opened the festival on Friday night[2].
  • circuitGROUNDS brought big screens, pyro and hanging acrobats[1].
  • neonGARDEN brought back its shipping-container build, now curved around the back of the DJ booth[1].
  • stereoBLOOM earned praise as the cozy stage, and Casa Bacardí became the go-to sunset and house meetup spot[1].
  • Between sets: carnival rides, arcade games and a new Kandi Casino[5].

What Got Better

Both recaps we read said Insomniac clearly listened to feedback from 2025.

  • Wider walkways between kineticFIELD, circuitGROUNDS and stereoBLOOM, which had been bottlenecks in past years[5].
  • Free water stations added to cut down on lines[1].
  • Less crowding. EDMTunes said no stage felt overpacked, even during headliners[1].
  • Food, drinks, vendors and restrooms were "noticeably better," and finding your friends was easier[5].

What Still Needs Work

  • Phone theft. EDMTunes flagged it as the weekend's one real problem, especially near the end of the festival[1]. Keep your phone in a zipped front pocket or on a phone leash, and turn on Find My before you go in. More tips on our safety page.
  • The neighbors. Residents near Tinker Field told Spectrum News 13 that the bass rattles their windows and that some festivalgoers wander into yards. They also credited a bigger police presence for making this year better than last[3].
  • Getting there. The Orange County Sheriff's Office ran its largest-ever event zone for EDC, with doubled traffic fines and towing. Some nearby private lots charged $40 to $50 a night[4]. Plan your ride before you go.
  • Bass depth. Bass fans got good sets, but fewer of them than in past years. We are hoping 2027 brings back a deeper heavy bass lineup.

Hotel EDC Orlando

For the first time, Hotel EDC came to the East Coast. It took over the Margaritaville Resort Orlando from November 6 to 9, with poolside sets, themed rooms and official afterparties running until 6 AM[1]. More than 5,000 people went over the weekend[1]. The bill included Svdden Death, Kai Wachi, Boys Noize, ALLEYCVT, Levity, Jkyl & Hyde, Maddix and LAYZ[1][6]. The Festival Babes called the after-hours sets "some of the BEST sets I have seen from the artists"[6]. Insomniac has not said yet whether Hotel EDC will return in 2027.

EDC Orlando 2027

EDC Orlando returns November 5 to 7, 2027 at Tinker Field for its 16th edition. Tickets went on sale November 13, with three-day GA, GA+ and 21+ VIP passes and payment plans starting with a $5 deposit[8]. It is already on the PLURGASM 2027 rave schedule.
